changelog:
The Circle Is Complete — from voice satellite to full home terminal.

Mini Player Control: full music interface collapses into a circular cover ring at screen edge. Album art, playback progress, play/pause state. Cover rotates while playing, returns upright after pause, crossfades on track change. Tap center to play/pause, tap cover to expand. Draggable, remembers position across portrait/landscape. Reveals browser pages while keeping music controls. Path: Settings → Interaction → Media Player → Mini Player Control. Screen stays awake during playback.

Lyrics & Progress: synced lyrics follow actual heard audio with Sendspin buffering and sync offset. Retries, fallback query, duration validation added. Fixed lyrics starting mid-track after change, jumping to first line after pause, delayed timing, local progress stuck after upstream seek. Softer transitions. Full metadata progress bar now seekable — tap to jump, instant update, reconciles with server.

Streaming TTS Fixed: waits for real PCM before taking over, empty streams no longer interrupt started URL speech. Empty stream-end closes URL session correctly; watchdog prevents stuck Responding state.

Video Call Self-View: local picture-in-picture during calls. Front camera mirrored in preview only, natural orientation sent to peer. Rear camera removes mirror automatically. Camera flip outside preview. Portrait, landscape, unusual DPI supported.

Home Passcode: 4 or 6 digit, custom auto-lock delay. Lock immediately from sidebar. Optional keypad shuffle. Optional brute-force protection. Settings time does not count as inactivity. Path: Settings → Device Services → Home Passcode.

Bluetooth Presence: ESPHome 2026.8.1 compatibility. IRK support for rotating private addresses. Root/Shizuku reads system bonding data. MAC exact match priority, IRK fallback only. Auto-read and validated, no manual paste needed.

Settings reorganized. Portal Support 1.2.0 adds media volume diagnostic sensor. Echo Show Support 1.1.1 fixes DEX loading. Lock-screen animation, overlay bitmap, call layouts, Bluetooth coordination, translations stabilized.
